name: Monash University
description: Monash University is a public research university founded in 1958, with its main campuses in Melbourne. It is a member of the Group of Eight and is Australia's largest university by enrolment, with faculties spanning medicine, engineering, business, law and the arts.
whyIncluded: Among the most-searched overseas universities from Singapore in 2025 (KiasuParents, a Singapore parents' website), and a Group of Eight university on both the Singapore Medical Council and the Singapore Institute of Legal Education (SILE) (Legal Profession (Qualified Persons) Rules) recognition lists.

livingCosts.summary: Monash's own estimate for a shared rental near Clayton, utilities, food, transport, phone and entertainment for 12 months, using the middle of its ranges.
livingCosts.notes: Monash 'Cost of living' page (no year given; 2026 is the year it was read), weekly range midpoints x 52/12. Housing: shared rental in the Clayton area $275-$380/wk + gas, water and electricity $40-$80/wk. Food: groceries and eating out $150-$500/wk. Transport: public transport $25-$50/wk. Personal: phone and internet $20-$46/wk + entertainment $150-$300/wk. Other columns: on campus $350-$450/wk, homestay $275-$430/wk, private rental $500-$750/wk. Monash's headline is A$30,000-$45,000 per year. monash.edu blocks automated access (Cloudflare challenge); the page was read on 2026-09-30 through a text rendering (r.jina.ai) of the official URL.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Computer Science
programmes.summary: 2027 annual tuition for international students for a full-time year. Excludes the student services fee and overseas student health cover; fees are reviewed each year.
programmes.notes: C2001, Clayton campus. 2027 international fee per 48 credit points (standard full-time year), from the international view of the page; the default (domestic) view shows the domestic full-fee rate of A$45,440, which was recorded here by mistake before this correction. Monash's course pages default to the domestic view; the international fee is shown with the '?international=true' audience switch, which is how this figure was read on 2026-09-30 through a text rendering (r.jina.ai) of this URL because monash.edu blocks automated access (Cloudflare challenge). Excludes the Student Services and Amenities Fee (Monash's SSAF page blocks automated access, so it could not be verified; the 2027 statutory cap is about A$386) and OSHC. Fees reviewed annually. Fee history (added 2026-10-04) comes from Monash's own course-guide PDFs, read through a text rendering (r.jina.ai) of the official monash.edu URL because monash.edu blocks automated access; each guide's fee footnote reads '<year> quoted fees ... per 48 credit points', and the year named is the fee year (the 2027 guides' '2026 quoted' figures differ from the 2027 figures on the course pages). Monash's per-year course pages (/find-a-course/2024/..., /2025/...) render the current 2027 fee, so they cannot supply history. Rows: 2026: A$55,500 (2027 International Undergraduate Course Guide ('2026 quoted fees')).
